description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GrainExtensionNotInstalledException' used in the Orleans runtime to signal the absence of a required grain extension. It includes various constructors for different initialization scenarios and is marked as serializable.

classes.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception thrown when a grain extension is not installed. It inherits from OrleansException and provides multiple constructors for different error initialization scenarios.

methods.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a default message.

methods.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor with custom message and inner exception.
